messages:
Riley: Pushed a compact roles layout variant to the shared file: https://figma.com/file/yyy
Tess: Noted. The compact variant hides role descriptions; users reported confusion in tests last week
Noah: Could we add a hover affordance that reveals the description on desktop, and a tappable disclosure on mobile?
Mina: Hover-only is inaccessible. If we include hover reveal, we need focusable targets and a visible caret so keyboard users can expand.
Oliver: For invite flow, the email validation UX is odd: invalid emails silently fail in bulk paste. Need inline error for each token
Riley: Good catch. Let's show inline red pills for invalid entries and an aggregate error at top
Tess: Accessibility: color of error pills uses same red as links in our theme. Use a variant with higher contrast and an icon
Noah: Also consider grouping duplicate emails into one pill with a count instead of blocking send
Mina: SSO toggle state labelling: 'On/Off' alongside the label is still ambiguous for screen reader users. Recommend 'SSO enforced: Yes/No' visually
Oliver: I like explicit phrasing. Also, the tooltip wording for SSO mentions 'single sign-on provider' which is confusing for customers with multiple providers
Riley: Change tooltip to 'Manage SSO providers in Organization settings > Authentication'
Tess: Audit log deep link: when you click "View audit" we should open a right-side panel instead of navigating away; keep context on roles list
Noah: Panel should include breadcrumbs and a Clear filters button. Also add an anchor link to copy current filter state
Mina: Keyboard trap in current drawer: when drawer opens focus isn't moved to the drawer header. Need focus management
Oliver: Dev note: make sure drawer close restores focus to the original control
design-bot: New frames uploaded: roles-compact-v2, invite-paste-validation, audit-panel-sidecar
Riley: Tiny copy note: button 'Add role' vs 'Create role'  both used across app. Pick one.
Tess: Align to 'Create role' in primary action patterns
Noah: I'll run a quick screen-reader pass on the invite drawer after changes are in staging
Mina: Adding to checklist: aria-live for bulk invite summary, aria-describedby for role descriptions, keyboard accessible expanders
Oliver: Filed ENG-12401 for invite validation + focus restore
Riley: Thanks all, will merge compact variant into main figma file after Tess updates copy
design-bot: Checklist updated in the figma comments
